page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-tee.6xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. The host hardware features 24 dedicated vCPUs backed by an Intel Xeon 8469C processor running at a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. System memory totals 128.0 GB, providing an allocation of 5.33 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single dedicated GPU equipped with 96 GB of total VRAM.

Networking capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 15 Gbps. The configuration provides no bundled local ephemeral storage, meaning all operational data, operating system installations, and persistence layers rely entirely on network-attached block volumes. Additionally, the instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The balance of 24 dedicated Intel Xeon cores and 96 GB of accelerator memory delivers high memory capacity per GPU without the coordination overhead of multi-card setups. The reliance on remote storage represents a tradeoff that bounds local I/O to network storage limits. This hardware profile is appropriate for machine learning model inference, single-node deep learning fine-tuning, scientific computing, ETL data pipelines, and video rendering workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-tee.6xlarge is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance designed for compute and memory-intensive acceleration tasks. Hardware acceleration is handled by one GPU providing 96 GB of dedicated VRAM, making it capable of hosting large model parameters and working sets in memory. Networking is provisioned with a 15 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The instance features no local storage, requiring network-attached storage for disk operations, and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The pairing of 24 dedicated host cores with a single high-capacity 96 GB GPU ensures efficient single-accelerator utilization. This instance profile fits machine learning inference, model fine-tuning, data science jobs, ETL pipelines, and parallel compute workloads.
